content_metadata.description: A detailed guide on how to transfer the balance from a previous Provident Fund (PF) account to a new one, focusing on activating the Universal Account Number (UAN) and ensuring employer details are up-to-date.

qAndA.answer: Ensure that the previous employer has updated the employee's exit date in the old PF account before logging into the new account.
qAndA.question: What is the speaker's advice before logging into the new PF account?

qAndA.answer: In the "Important Links" section on the bottom right of the EPFO login page under "Activate UAN" option.
qAndA.question: Where can users find the option to activate their UAN?

qAndA.answer: The speaker is referring to the employee's exit date or the last day of work at the previous company.
qAndA.question: What is the speaker referring to as 'ending date'?

qAndA.answer: In the "Service History" section under the "View" tab after logging into their PF account.
qAndA.question: Where can users check if their previous employer has updated their exit date?

qAndA.answer: By providing either the previous UAN number or the Member ID of their previous PF account.
qAndA.question: What are the two ways to initiate the transfer request in the online services portal?

activities.description: The speaker opens a google chrome tab
The speaker types epfo in the google search bar
The speaker clicks on the first result epfindia.gov.in
The speaker hovers the mouse over the option KYC Updation (Member)
The speaker clicks on KYC Updation (Member)
The speaker hovers the mouse over Activate UAN
The speaker hovers the mouse over the textbox to enter the UAN number
The speaker moves the mouse to the top of the page and clicks on manage
The speaker hovers the mouse over Service history
The speaker clicks on Service history
The speaker circles the column DOE EPF and highlights the text NOT AVAILABLE
The speaker circles the text NOT AVAILABLE under the column DOE EPF
The speaker clicks on Online Services
The speaker clicks on ONE MEMBER - ONE EPF ACCOUNT (TRANSFER REQUEST)
The speaker circles the option Previous Employer
The speaker enters the member ID in the textbox Member ID / UAN
The speaker clicks on Get Details
The speaker clicks on Ok in a popup message that reads No previous employment details found against this UAN
The speaker circles the option Previous Employer again

Employees' Provident Fund Organisation, India website

climax.description: The speaker initiates the transfer request by providing the Member ID/UAN and clicks 'Get Details', encountering an issue, as no previous employment details are found.

storylines.description: The speaker is explaining how to transfer the balance from a previous Provident Fund (PF) account to the new one. The process requires activating the Universal Account Number (UAN) provided by the new employer, ensuring the previous employer has updated the employee's exit date, accessing the online services portal and selecting the "One Member - One PF Account (Transfer Request)" option, providing either the previous UAN number or the Member ID of the previous account, and authenticating with an OTP.
